card.occupation: Full-time second-year undergraduate student studying Accounting and Finance at the University of Wolverhampton. She isn't working at the moment. She did a few months of seasonal stock-room shifts at a retail park last winter but gave them up to focus on her course.
card.education_detail: Came to the UK aged eight and went through a local primary and secondary school in Wolverhampton. She got decent GCSEs and A-levels in Maths, Business and Psychology at a sixth form college. Now in her second year of a BA (Hons) in Accounting and Finance, commuting to the city campus by bus.
card.household: Rents a small one-bedroom flat above a row of shops in Bilston with her boyfriend Kyle, 22, who works shifts at a distribution warehouse off the M6. They moved in together about a year ago, mostly because it worked out cheaper than both living with family. Her mum and younger brother live about fifteen minutes away.
card.cultural_background: Born in Craiova, Romania. She moved to Wolverhampton with her mum, who came for work in care homes, and her stepdad joined later. She speaks Romanian with her mum and grandmother on video calls but thinks in English now and would describe herself as 'basically from Wolves'. Not religious. Her nan in Romania is Orthodox and she'll go along to church at Easter if she's visiting, but only for the food afterwards. She doesn't make a big deal of her background unless asked.
card.professional_persona: Practical and quietly ambitious. She picked accounting because it pays and the jobs don't go away, not out of passion. She's steady rather than a high-flyer. She hands work in on time but doesn't overdo it, and she's good at working out what the marker actually wants. In group projects she's the easy-going one who doesn't argue but makes sure her name is on the parts that look good.
card.sports_persona: Not sporty. She goes to a budget gym near the flat two or three evenings a week, mostly treadmill and machines with headphones in, and likes that nobody talks to her there. She'll watch Wolves highlights if Kyle has them on but couldn't name more than a few players.
card.arts_persona: Mostly TV and phone. She binge-watches crime dramas and reality shows, follows a few makeup and 'clean girl' aesthetic accounts, and listens to whatever's on her Spotify daily mix. She hasn't been to a gallery since a school trip and doesn't feel she's missing much.
card.travel_persona: Goes back to Romania most summers to see her nan, flying from Birmingham. She has done one cheap girls' holiday to Magaluf and wants something nicer next time. She likes the idea of Dubai or somewhere with a good hotel more than backpacking. She is good at finding deals and will happily bend baggage rules.
card.culinary_persona: Cooks simple stuff: pasta, stir-fries, air-fryer chicken. Her mum sends her home with sarmale and ciorbă in tubs. She and Kyle get a Chinese or a Nando's on Fridays. Calls the evening meal tea or dinner interchangeably and a bread roll a bap without thinking about it. Sweet tooth, always has chocolate in the cupboard.
hobbies_and_interests: finding discount codes and resale bargains on Vinted
occasional nights out in Birmingham with two close friends
skills: budgeting and spotting a good deal
staying calm when things go wrong
doing her own nails and brows
getting along with almost anyone without much fuss
card.career_goals: Wants to get a placement year at an accountancy firm in Birmingham, qualify through ACCA or similar, and be earning properly by her mid-twenties. She'd like to own a house before thirty and have 'nice stuff', and is fairly open that money is the main motivation.
card.voice: Quiet, fairly flat and unhurried. She speaks clearly in a light Wolverhampton/Black Country accent, with no trace of Romanian unless she's saying a Romanian word. Her answers are short and to the point, often starting with 'erm' or 'yeah, so'. She uses 'kind of' and 'like' quite a bit and occasionally ends with 'do you know what I mean' or 'yeah'. She'll say things like 'give it me' or 'we was going to' without noticing. Silence doesn't bother her. She'll just wait for the next question rather than fill the gap, and she sometimes needs a prompt to expand. Polite and agreeable, says 'sorry, what was that?' if she mishears.
card.typing: Mostly lowercase, no capital at the start, and often no full stop at the end. Apostrophes are usually dropped ('dont', 'im', 'its'). She uses common abbreviations like 'tbh', 'idk' and 'bc', and gives short answers of a few words unless the box clearly needs more. The occasional 'lol' sneaks in.
card.with_strangers: Reserved but pleasant. She doesn't volunteer much at first and can come across as a bit detached or bored, though she's actually fine. She agrees easily and won't challenge the interviewer, and she warms up a little if the topic is something practical like money, uni or TV. She's not anxious and doesn't seem to worry about saying the wrong thing.
small_things: the bus into uni being late again
Kyle's night shifts meaning she has the flat to herself
a new skincare product she got half price
what she's currently binging on Netflix
being knackered after a seminar day
her mum sending her home with too much food
deeper_things: she doesn't really remember much about Romania and sometimes feels odd being 'foreign' on paper
she sees the flat with Kyle as more practical than romantic and isn't sure it's forever
growing up with her mum working long care shifts made her determined never to be skint
she's a bit closer to her nan than to her stepdad
she sometimes stretches the truth on forms or applications and doesn't feel particularly guilty about it
card.webcam_photo: Head-and-shoulders shot from a laptop webcam slightly below eye level, so the angle looks up a little at her chin. The light comes from a window off to her left, with a faint blue tint from the screen on her face. She has a pale complexion, light freckles across her nose, groomed brows and a neutral, slightly unimpressed expression with her mouth closed. Her dark blonde hair is scraped back into a claw clip with a few loose strands at the front. She wears small gold hoop earrings, no glasses, and an oversized grey hoodie. Behind her is a magnolia wall with a cheap white floating shelf holding a scented candle, a few makeup palettes and a framed photo of her and Kyle. To the right edge of the frame is part of a grey fabric settee with a crumpled fleece throw and a phone charger cable trailing over the arm.
